question: What beautiful floor art do we make with colored powders during Diwali? 🪔
explanation: Awesome! We make colorful Rangoli patterns on the floor to welcome guests and celebrate! 🌺
hint: It starts with the letter 'R'.

question: What natural item can we use to make a soft and sweet-smelling Rangoli? 🌸
explanation: Great job! Flower petals make our Rangoli look bright and smell very nice! 🌸
hint: They fall from blooming flowers.

question: Which shape looks like a beautiful sun in the middle of a Rangoli? ☀️
explanation: Super! A big round circle in the center makes our design look complete and bright! 🟡
hint: It is completely round.

question: What are the small clay pots we light up during festivals called? 🕯️
explanation: Awesome! Diyas are small clay lamps that spread light and joy everywhere! 🪔
hint: We fill them with oil and a cotton wick.

question: What tool is best to paint bright colors on a small clay Diya? 🎨
explanation: Great job! A soft paint brush helps us put beautiful colors on the Diya! 🖌️
hint: It has soft bristles for wet colors.

question: Which bright color makes our festive art look super happy and warm? 💛
explanation: Super! Yellow is a happy color, just like the bright sun! 💛
hint: It is the color of a sunflower.

question: What do we make with folded paper to wish our friends Happy New Year? 💌
explanation: Awesome! We make beautiful greeting cards to write sweet wishes for our friends! 💌
hint: You fold a paper in half and draw on it.

question: What sticky thing do we use to put glitter on a greeting card? 🧴
explanation: Great job! Glue helps all the shiny glitter stick nicely to our paper! 🧴
hint: It comes in a bottle or a stick.

question: Which shape is perfect to draw on a Christmas greeting card? ⭐
explanation: Super! A bright star looks amazing on top of a drawn Christmas tree! ⭐
hint: It twinkles in the night sky.

question: What shape is beautiful to draw on an Eid greeting card? 🌙
explanation: Awesome! A beautiful crescent moon is a special symbol for the Eid festival! 🌙
hint: It shines in the sky at night.

question: What safe tool do we use to cut colored paper for decorations? ✂️
explanation: Great job! Kid-friendly scissors help us cut paper into beautiful shapes! ✂️
hint: It has two loops for your fingers.

question: What do we call a string of leaves and flowers hung on the door? 🌿
explanation: Super! A Toran makes our front door look very welcoming and festive! 🚪
hint: It starts with the letter 'T'.

question: Which orange flower is mostly used to make festive garlands? 🌼
explanation: Awesome! Marigold flowers are bright orange and yellow, perfect for festivals! 🌼
hint: It is also called 'Genda' in Hindi.

question: What colorful paper art do we fly in the sky on Makar Sankranti? 🪁
explanation: Great job! We make and fly colorful kites high up in the breezy sky! 🪁
hint: It has a tail and flies on a string.

question: What shape is a traditional flying kite? 🔷
explanation: Super! A kite is usually shaped like a beautiful diamond! 🔷
hint: It has four points and looks like a tilted square.

question: What colorful art do we tie on our brother's wrist during Raksha Bandhan? 🧵
explanation: Awesome! A Rakhi is a beautiful decorated thread that shows love! 🧵
hint: We make it with thread, beads, and glitter.

question: Which colored powder do we splash during the Holi festival? 🩷
explanation: Great job! Gulal is the bright, soft, and safe color powder we use to play Holi! 🩷
hint: It comes in pink, green, and yellow.

question: What do we add to our drawings to make them sparkly and shiny? ✨
explanation: Super! Glitter catches the light and makes our festival art look magical! ✨
hint: It is shiny and comes in small sprinkles.

question: What do we call a beautiful paper lamp hung outside during Diwali? 🏮
explanation: Awesome! A Kandil (or paper lantern) glows brightly and looks beautiful! 🏮
hint: It is also known as a paper lantern.

question: How should a festive art room look? 🎊
explanation: Great job! A festive room should be full of bright colors and joy! 🎊
hint: It looks like a rainbow!

question: What do we call it when we repeat a shape again and again in art? 🔁
explanation: Super! Patterns make our Rangoli and borders look very neat and pretty! 🔁
hint: Like red-blue-red-blue.

question: If we mix Red and Yellow paint, what festive color do we get? 🧡
explanation: Awesome! Mixing red and yellow gives us a bright orange color! 🧡
hint: It is the color of a carrot.

question: What do we use our thumbs and paint to make on a greeting card? 👍
explanation: Great job! Thumbprints can be turned into cute balloons, flowers, or bugs on cards! 👍
hint: You dip your biggest finger in paint.

question: What can we tie around a handmade greeting card to make it special? 🎀
explanation: Super! A beautiful ribbon tied in a bow makes our card look like a gift! 🎀
hint: It is smooth and used for wrapping presents.

question: What is the best way to draw a perfect straight line for a card border? 📏
explanation: Awesome! A ruler helps us draw very straight and neat lines! 📏
hint: It is also called a scale.

question: What is a simple way to draw a perfect circle for a Rangoli design? ⭕
explanation: Great job! Tracing around a round bangle gives us a perfect circle! ⭕
hint: It is worn on the wrist.

question: What do we write inside a festival greeting card? ✍️
explanation: Super! We write sweet messages and good wishes to make our friends smile! 🌟
hint: Things like 'Happy Diwali' or 'Merry Christmas'.

question: Which material is soft and used to make small clay toys for festivals? 🏺
explanation: Awesome! Clay is soft mud that we can shape into toys and diyas! 🏺
hint: It gets hard when it dries.

question: What do we call the art of folding paper to make birds and boats? 🦢
explanation: Great job! Origami is the magic of folding one paper into beautiful shapes! 🦢
hint: It is a famous art from Japan.

question: What do we draw on a card to show love? ❤️
explanation: Super! A red heart is the perfect shape to show love to our family! ❤️
hint: It is red and beats in your chest.

question: Which tree do we decorate with shiny bells and stars in December? 🌲
explanation: Awesome! Decorating a Christmas tree is a fun and beautiful art activity! 🌲
hint: It is green and cone-shaped.

question: What do we hang on the walls that has small triangular flags? 🎏
explanation: Great job! Colorful paper bunting makes any room look ready for a party! 🎏
hint: They are stringed paper triangles.

question: Which of these makes a greeting card look very neat? 📐
explanation: Super! A neatly folded card shows we made it with lots of care! 📐
hint: Pressing the edges nicely.

question: What helps us stick two pieces of paper together quickly? 🖍️
explanation: Awesome! A glue stick is clean and very easy for kids to use! 🖍️
hint: It looks like a big lip balm but for paper.

question: What drawing tool gives us very bright and waxy colors? 🖍️
explanation: Great job! Crayons are smooth, waxy, and make our drawings look vibrant! 🖍️
hint: They come in a big box of colors.

question: What type of lines look like waves on an ocean? 〰️
explanation: Super! Wavy lines are soft and perfect for drawing water or borders! 〰️
hint: They curve up and down smoothly.

question: What is the very first step before drawing a design? 💭
explanation: Awesome! We must think and imagine our beautiful design before we start! 💭
hint: You use your brain to do this.

question: What kind of Rangoli is made using wet white rice paste? 🤍
explanation: Great job! Alpana or Kolam is a beautiful floor art made with wet rice paste! 🤍
hint: It starts with the letter 'A'.

question: What do we use to clean up a pencil mistake in our drawing? 🧽
explanation: Super! An eraser gently removes our mistakes so we can try again! 🧽
hint: It is soft and made of rubber.

question: What colorful item do we blow up to decorate a party room? 🎈
explanation: Awesome! Colorful balloons make every celebration feel like a big party! 🎈
hint: They pop if you poke them.

question: Which of these is a joyful and bright color? 💖
explanation: Great job! Pink is a bright, happy color perfect for festive art! 💖
hint: It is the color of a lotus flower.

question: How do we make our handmade cards look special? 🌟
explanation: Super! Doing our work neatly shows how much we care! 🌟
hint: Keeping things clean and tidy.

question: What do we use to tie a paper Toran so we can hang it? 🧵
explanation: Awesome! A strong thread holds all our paper leaves and flowers together! 🧵
hint: It is used for sewing.

question: What pattern is made of dots placed in a row? 💬
explanation: Great job! Dotted lines are fun to draw and make cute borders for cards! 💬
hint: Dot, dot, dot, dot...

question: What is the best thing about festive art? 🥰
explanation: Super! Making art with our own hands is the most fun part of festivals! 🥰
hint: Using your creativity and hands.

question: Which animal shape is fun to draw for a jungle theme card? 🦁
explanation: Awesome! A drawing of a lion looks brave and beautiful on a card! 🦁
hint: It is the king of the jungle.

question: Which lines look like mountains going up and down? ⛰️
explanation: Great job! Zigzag lines are sharp and pointy, just like mountain peaks! 📉
hint: They look like the letter 'Z'.

question: What can we stick on a Diya to make it look fancy? 💎
explanation: Super! Shiny stickers and beads make our painted Diyas look like jewels! 💎
hint: They have glue on the back.

question: What colors should we use to draw a bright sunny day? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! Yellow for the sun and blue for the sky make a beautiful day picture! ☀️
hint: The colors of the sun and the sky.

question: What feelings should our festive art spread? 😊
explanation: Great job! Festivals and art are all about spreading love, smiles, and joy! 😊
hint: Being very, very happy.
